name: stunning_ui
description: A glassmorphic, physics-driven Flutter UI toolkit. One seed colour + style derives a full theme; accessible by default; chainable .stunning() effects.

components.name: StunningAccent
components.description: Recolours an entire subtree from a single colour, without rebuilding the whole app's theme.

components.name: StunningAccordion
components.description: A glassmorphic accordion widget that smoothly expands and collapses.

components.name: StunningAnimatedTheme
components.description: Animates smoothly between [StunningTheme]s whenever [theme] changes — every token (colour scheme, glass blur, glow, border, motion, palette gradients) interpolates via [StunningTheme.lerp].

components.name: StunningAppBar
components.description: A glassmorphic top app bar that integrates perfectly with the Stunning UI ecosystem.

components.name: StunningAvatar
components.description: A circular avatar that renders, in order of precedence, an [image], then text [initials], then an [icon], and finally a default person glyph.

components.name: StunningBadge
components.description: A small count / status pill, optionally anchored to a [child].

components.name: StunningBarChart
components.description: A premium, animated bar chart designed for Enterprise and SaaS dashboards.

components.name: StunningBottomNav
components.description: A highly interactive, floating bottom navigation bar with elastic physics and neon glow.

components.name: StunningButton
components.description: A highly interactive, physics-based button.

components.name: StunningButtonSize
components.description: Size scale for [StunningButton].

components.name: StunningButtonVariant
components.description: Defines the visual style of the [StunningButton].

components.name: StunningCarousel
components.description: A 3D depth-scaling carousel slider that highlights the center widget and shrinks side elements.

components.name: StunningCheckbox
components.description: A physics-y, glowing checkbox built on [StunningTappable].

components.name: StunningDataTable
components.description: A revolutionary, highly customizable data table.

components.name: StunningDialog
components.description: A centred, glassmorphic dialog panel: an optional accent-tinted [icon], a [title], an optional [message] (or arbitrary [content]), and an actions row.

components.name: StunningDivider
components.description: A thin, theme-aware divider line.

components.name: StunningEffectTier
components.description: Rendering tier for glass effects.

components.name: StunningGlassScope
components.description: Coalesces every descendant [GlassSurface] into a single backdrop blur pass (via [BackdropGroup]).

components.name: StunningGradients
components.description: Ready-to-use gradient stop lists derived from the harmony.

components.name: StunningHarmony
components.description: How the secondary / tertiary colours are derived when the developer only supplies a primary seed (or wants a specific colour relationship).

components.name: StunningNavItem
components.description: Represents an individual item inside the [StunningBottomNav].

components.name: StunningPagination
components.description: A compact, theme-aware page navigation control.

components.name: StunningPalette
components.description: A complete, harmonious, WCAG-AA colour system derived from one (or two) brand colours — entirely in HCT space via `material_color_utilities`.

components.name: StunningProgressBar
components.description: A theme-aware linear progress indicator.

components.name: StunningProgressRing
components.description: A theme-aware circular progress indicator.

components.name: StunningRadio
components.description: A generic, theme-aware single-choice radio button — the Stunning analogue of Material's `Radio<T>`.

components.name: StunningRole
components.description: A colour role that owns a full Tailwind-style 50→950 tonal ramp.

components.name: StunningSegmentedControl
components.description: A modern, glassmorphic segmented control with a sliding background highlight.

components.name: StunningSelect
components.description: A generic, overlay-based dropdown/select that floats its menu in an [OverlayPortal] instead of expanding inline.

components.name: StunningSemantic
components.description: One brand-tuned semantic colour (success / warning / error / info) with an AA-guaranteed foreground, a container fill, and its own 50→950 ramp.

components.name: StunningSemantics
components.description: The four brand-tuned semantic colours.

components.name: StunningShimmer
components.description: A GPU-accelerated skeleton loading wrapper that applies a sliding highlight effect.

components.name: StunningSidebar
components.description: A glassmorphic drawer/sidebar with blurred backdrop effects and animated selection states.

components.name: StunningSidebarItem
components.description: An individual menu item for the [StunningSidebar].

components.name: StunningSkeleton
components.description: A premium skeleton loader with a continuous glass shimmer effect.

components.name: StunningSlider
components.description: A draggable value slider with a theme-aware, glowing thumb.

components.name: StunningSpring
components.description: A motion "spring" token (duration + bounce) derived from the active style.

components.name: StunningSwitch
components.description: A highly interactive, theme-aware toggle switch.

components.name: StunningTableStyle
components.description: Defines the visual layout of the data table.

components.name: StunningTabs
components.description: A segmented control where a glowing pill slides behind the active tab.

components.name: StunningTappable
components.description: The shared interaction primitive for every tappable Stunning component.

components.name: StunningTextField
components.description: A highly interactive, theme-aware text field with focus animations.

components.name: StunningTheme
components.description: The central design engine.

components.name: StunningTiltCard
components.description: A 3D interactive glass card that tilts toward the pointer on web/desktop (hover) AND toward the finger on mobile (pan), springing back to flat on release.

components.name: StunningToast
components.description: A premium, floating toast notification that slides up from the bottom.

components.name: StunningTooltip
components.description: A theme-styled tooltip that wraps any [child] and reveals a short [message] on long-press (touch) or hover (pointer).

components.name: StunningUI
components.description: Package-level glass helpers.

components.name: StunningUIStyle
components.description: Defines the core DNA of how the UI behaves and looks.
